# Guzia Bilateral High School, Bogura

> Government-recognised secondary school for Classes 6–10 in Guzia, Shibganj,
> Bogura, Bangladesh. EIIN 119825 · established 1958 · Rajshahi Education Board.

## Pages

- [Home](https://guzia-high-school.vercel.app/): overview, acting headmaster's message, programmes, upcoming events
- [About](https://guzia-high-school.vercel.app/about): history, mission and leadership
- [Academics](https://guzia-high-school.vercel.app/academics): NCTB curriculum for Classes 6–10
- [Admission](https://guzia-high-school.vercel.app/admission): requirements and the online application form
- [News & events](https://guzia-high-school.vercel.app/news): notices and the school calendar
- [Gallery](https://guzia-high-school.vercel.app/gallery)
- [Contact](https://guzia-high-school.vercel.app/contact): address, phone and contact form

## School facts

- Name: Guzia Bilateral High School
- EIIN: 119825
- MPO code: 7610041302
- Founded: 1958
- Board: Rajshahi
- Classes: 6–10 (secondary level)
- Address: Guzia, Shibganj, Bogura, Bangladesh

## Portal

Sign-in: /login (admin, teacher, student, parent). The authenticated portals are
/admin, /teacher, /student and /parent; they are excluded from indexing.

## AI features

- At-risk student classifier: a logistic regression trained in-house, with the
  contributing factors shown for every score.
- Teacher toolkit: question papers, lesson plans, flashcards/mind maps, and a
  source-grounded assistant that cites the page it used.

## Technical

- Web: Next.js (App Router), API: NestJS with Prisma/PostgreSQL, JWT in an
  httpOnly cookie.
- API documentation: /api/docs on the API host.
- Source and setup: https://github.com/khanshifaul/guzia-high-school
